description: Corrects 121C01 model/reasoning level mislabeling. All 'max' terminology is mapped to 'high' equivalents. Original 121C01 files are NOT modified — this overlay is authoritative for 121CN and all downstream work.
correction_rationale: 121C01 task file specified 'max' reasoning, but subagent environment only supports 'high'. The actual model was qclaw/pool-glm-5.2 (not night pool) with high reasoning. All semantic review in 121C01 was performed at high level, not max. 121CN uses qclaw/pool-glm-5.2-night with high reasoning. The correction overlay ensures status axes reflect reality.
note: All 10 121C01 evidence cards have semantic_review_status=MAX_REVIEW_COMPLETE in their files. Per this overlay, they should be read as GLM52_HIGH_REVIEW_COMPLETE. The 121C01 review was performed by qclaw/pool-glm-5.2 at high reasoning, NOT by qclaw/pool-glm-5.2-night and NOT at max. The 121C01 run-state model_note explicitly states this.
overlay_principle: Read original files for content. Apply this overlay when interpreting semantic_review_status values. Do not modify original 121C01 files.
